title: Proximal Strengthening for the Management of Wrist Pain
brief_summary: This study will be a randomized controlled trial comparing proximal strengthening vs. traditional hand therapy for patients with wrist pain. Patients will attend 2 hand therapy sessions per week for 4 weeks. Change in patient function and pain as measured by the patient rated wrist evaluation will be the primary outcome of interest
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Wrist pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* \<8 years of age
* any neurological disorder
* Juvenile rheumatoid arthritis
* juvenile idiopathic arthritis
* Wrist fractures \< 16 weeks from date of injury or surgery
* Tendon repair
* Nerve injury or repair
* Inability to follow directions
* Inability to attend follow-up appointments
